profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer | Front-End Engineering | UI Platforms & Design Systems | JavaScript & TypeScript
profile.summary:
I'm a Staff Software Engineer who loves building thoughtful, well-designed user interfaces, and the systems that make them possible.

I've spent my career working on front-end applications, component libraries, design systems, and UI platforms. At ServiceNow, I've worked primarily on UI Builder, where I've led development of major features and served as a technical lead for a small engineering team.

I'm happiest working at the intersection of engineering, design, and user experience. I especially enjoy solving tricky UI problems, building reusable components and tools, thinking about accessibility, and helping other engineers do their best work.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed complex front-end experiences for UI Builder, ServiceNow's visual WYSIWYG interface builder, using JavaScript, TypeScript, and Seismic, a component-based JavaScript framework.
- Served as technical lead for a team of approximately 4-5 engineers, providing technical direction, code-level guidance, mentoring, and collaboration across product, design, and engineering.
- Lead development of major UI Builder and Now Experience All Menu (NEAM) Editor capabilities, including the Create Page wizard, dark theme support, and UI action customization.
- Completed a rotation with the Design System team, contributing to shared component and design-system initiatives and gaining broader perspective across ServiceNow's front-end ecosystem.
- Mentored engineers and help establish development practices while remaining hands-on in feature development and technical problem solving.

positions.title: Senior Front End Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Front-end Development · TypeScript · Web Accessibility · Design Systems

positions.title: Senior User Experience Engineer
positions.description:
- Built, tested, documented and maintained components for React Magma, an open-source React component library built with React 16.8+, Typescript and Emotion.
- Developed and styled the user interface for MindTap, an online higher-ed platform, built in React/Redux and Sass.  Ensured platform met WCAG compliance.
-Mentored junior team members on web development techniques such as ReactJS, CSS and styling, unit testing, and digital accessibility.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Front-end Development · TypeScript · Web Accessibility · Design Systems

positions.title: UI Developer
positions.description:
- Developed HTML/CSS/JavaScript user interfaces and features for Java-based web applications. 
- Built a microsite for data visualization using Highcharts library.

positions.description: Developed HTML/CSS/JavaScript user interfaces and features for various Cengage web applications built in ASP.NET/C#.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed HTML/CSS/JavaScript UIs and features for client websites. Built ASP.NET (C#) web services. Created functional specifications, wire-frames and user documentation for multiple applications.
